1\. Conventions
===============

2\. Entity relationships
========================

------------------

2.2 Content domain
------------------

![diagrams/erd-content.png](data:image/png;base64,)  
bookings and testimonials are linked only when a testimonial is attached to a real job; the link is optional and cleared if the booking is later removed.

3\. Table dictionary
====================

| **Table** | **Purpose** | **Notes that matter** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| admin\_users | Who may use the admin desk and what they may touch | Primary key is the auth user id. scopes is a validated array: bookings, content, settings, team. |
| occasions | Lookup of event types (wedding, outdooring, funeral and so on) | applies\_to lists the service kinds it suits. Data, not code: new occasions need no deployment. |
| services | Sellable offerings under each kind | starting\_price\_minor optional so the owner may hide prices. |
| packages | Named bundles with duration, deliverables, price | Display data only. Quote prices are copied, never referenced. |
| bookings | A client’s request and its lifecycle | Reference, hashed access token, consent versions, kind-dependent shape checks, crew window and the overlap constraint. |
| quotes, quote\_items | Versioned, itemised price offers | One live (sent) quote per booking; frozen once sent; total must equal the sum of items. |
| payments | Deposits and refunds | Append-only; provider and provider\_reference are unique together so a Paystack webhook can be deduplicated in Phase 2. |
| booking\_events | Timeline and audit trail | Append-only; visible\_to\_client decides what the status page shows. |
| blocked\_dates | Unavailable ranges set by admin | Daterange with a GiST index; the reason is private. |
| portfolio\_items, media\_assets | Showcase work and its images or videos | Publish requires consent and a timestamp; images need dimensions and alt text; videos need provider, id and a poster. |
| testimonials | Approved client quotes | Publish requires the client’s consent flag. |
| faqs | Question and answer pairs | Plain rows. |
| enquiries | Contact form messages | Consent version and time stored. |
| legal\_documents | Versioned Terms, Privacy, Booking Policy | A view returns the version currently in force; bookings store the version they accepted. |
| site\_settings | One row of business settings | Singleton enforced by a check on the key. Lead time, quote validity, contact details, budget bands. |
| email\_outbox | Pending and sent emails | Unique dedupe key; no public policy, service role only. |

--------------------

| **Type** | **Values** |
| --- | --- |
| service\_kind | photography, videography, design |
| booking\_status | new, reviewing, quoted, accepted, confirmed, completed, declined, cancelled, expired |
| quote\_status | draft, sent, accepted, expired, superseded, withdrawn |
| contact\_method | whatsapp, phone, email |
| time\_of\_day | morning, afternoon, evening, all\_day, unsure |
| media\_type, video\_provider | image, video\_embed; youtube, vimeo |
| publish\_status | draft, published |
| payment\_method, payment\_provider | momo, bank\_transfer, cash, card; manual, paystack |
| outbox\_status, enquiry\_status | pending, sent, failed, dead; new, replied, spam, closed |

4\. Integrity rules and where they live
=======================================

Each business rule from the PRD is enforced by the cheapest mechanism that cannot be bypassed. Application code adds friendly messages on top; it is never the only guard.

| **Rule** | **PRD** | **Mechanism in the schema** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A request follows the allowed status path only | BR-01 | bookings\_status\_guard trigger lists every legal (from, to) pair; anything else raises an exception |
| Quote prices are frozen once sent; total equals the sum of items | BR-02 | quotes\_guard and quote\_items\_guard triggers; generated line\_total\_minor |
| One crew: no overlapping confirmed jobs | BR-04 | bookings\_no\_crew\_overlap exclusion constraint using btree\_gist on tstzrange(starts\_at, ends\_at) where status is confirmed and kind is not design |
| A confirmed or completed job has a window | BR-03 | booking\_confirmed\_window check |
| Design requests carry no event date; crew jobs must | BR-05 | booking\_date\_shape and booking\_design\_dates checks |
| Only one live quote per booking | FR-33 | Partial unique index where status is sent |
| A repeated submission creates one booking | FR-15 | Unique idempotency\_key with on conflict do nothing in create\_booking\_request |
| Nothing unconsented is published | BR-08 | published\_requires\_consent on portfolio items; testimonial\_consent on testimonials |
| Images have alt text and dimensions; videos have a poster | NFR-05 | image\_shape and video\_shape checks |
| Payments and timeline cannot be rewritten | FR-34 | forbid\_update triggers |
| Public cannot read or write private data; admin needs MFA and scope | NFR-04 | RLS on every table; has\_scope() checks the scope and an aal2 session; booking functions executable by the service role only |
| Personal data is not kept forever | BR-10 | anonymise\_old\_bookings() run by the monthly retention job |

<table><tbody><tr><td><strong>WHY THE PUBLIC CANNOT WRITE DIRECTLY</strong><br>The database key used in the browser is public by design. If any table allowed anonymous inserts, anyone could script around the site’s rate limiting and validation. So there are no public write policies: the booking and enquiry endpoints run on the server, apply the limits, then call a function that only the service role may execute.</td></tr></tbody></table>

5\. Indexes and query patterns
==============================

| **Query** | **Index** | **Why** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Admin inbox: newest requests by status | bookings\_inbox\_idx (status, created\_at desc) | Equality on status then ordered range; serves the dashboard and the list |
| Calendar: jobs by date, open states only | bookings\_calendar\_idx (event\_date) partial on quoted, accepted, confirmed | Small index; excludes terminal states |
| Find by client email | bookings\_email\_idx | Support lookups |
| Public package list per service | packages\_service\_idx (service\_id, sort\_order) partial on active | Rendered on every refresh of a service page |
| Public portfolio by kind in order | portfolio\_public\_idx (kind, sort\_order) partial on published | Only published rows are indexed |
| Media for an item in order | media\_item\_idx (portfolio\_item\_id, position) | Gallery assembly |
| Blocked ranges overlapping a window | blocked\_dates\_during\_idx GiST | Range overlap queries |
| Outbox due now | email\_outbox\_due\_idx (next\_attempt\_at) partial on pending and failed | Retry job scans a handful of rows |
| Booking timeline | booking\_events\_idx (booking\_id, created\_at) | Detail page |

Expected volume is small (low thousands of bookings over several years), so these indexes are for correctness of access patterns and future headroom, not for rescue. Verify with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on realistic seed data before launch.

6\. Access policies
===================

| **Table** | **anon / public** | **admin: bookings** | **admin: content** | **admin: settings** | **admin: team** | **Service role** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| occasions, services, packages | Read active | Read | Read and write | Read | Read | All |
| portfolio\_items, media\_assets, testimonials, faqs | Read published | Read | Read and write | Read | Read | All |
| legal\_documents | Read effective versions | Read | Read | Read and write | Read | All |
| site\_settings | Read | Read | Read | Update | Read | All |
| bookings, quotes, quote\_items, payments, booking\_events, blocked\_dates, enquiries | None | Read and write | None | None | None | All |
| admin\_users | None | Own row | Own row | Own row | Read and write | All |
| email\_outbox | None | None | None | None | None | All |
| public\_unavailable\_dates (view) | Dates only | Dates | Dates | Dates | Dates | All |
| create\_booking\_request, accept\_quote (functions) | No | No | No | No | No | Execute |

Every admin policy calls has\_scope(...), which is true only for an active admin holding that scope **and** a session that has passed the second factor. The view public\_unavailable\_dates deliberately runs with its owner’s rights so it can answer from private tables, and returns dates only. Supabase will flag it as a security-definer view; that is intended and documented here.

7\. Retention and privacy
=========================

| **Data** | **Kept for** | **Then** | **Basis** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Booking personal fields (name, email, phone, brief, venue, links, token hash) | Proposed: 24 months after the event date or deadline for closed bookings | anonymise\_old\_bookings(24) replaces them with neutral values and revokes the link; the booking row and amounts remain | Storage limitation; period is a business decision to confirm |
| Payment entries and quote amounts | Proposed: as long as tax and accounting rules require (VERIFY with the accountant) | Retained unchanged; they contain no contact details | Record keeping |
| Enquiries | Proposed: 12 months | Delete rows (a short scheduled delete to be added with the retention job) | Data minimisation |
| Email outbox | 90 days after sending | Delete sent rows | Payloads may include names |
| Portfolio items and media | While consent stands | Unpublished immediately if consent is withdrawn | Consent |
| Consent records (policy versions on bookings and enquiries) | Same as the record | Anonymised together | Evidence of consent |

A client who asks for erasure is handled by running the anonymise step for that booking, after checking whether any record-keeping duty applies to the amounts. This is a procedure for a person to follow, not a self-service feature.

8\. Seed data and launch checklist
==================================

The seed file loads the proposed occasion list and the ten sub-services. It deliberately contains **no prices and no business details**: invented figures would be worse than none.

9\. Verification record
=======================

On 16 November 2026 the schema in Appendix A was applied to a fresh PostgreSQL 16 database. Supabase’s auth functions and roles were replaced with minimal stand-ins, and the default table privileges that Supabase grants to its API roles were reproduced, so RLS was the thing doing the restricting. The following behaviours were exercised and all produced the expected result:

| **Behaviour tested** | **Result** |
| --- | --- |
| Create a booking through create\_booking\_request | One booking, one timeline event, two outbox rows |
| Submit the same idempotency key again | Same reference returned; still one booking and one set of emails |
| Confirm without a work window | Rejected by check constraint |
| Confirm two overlapping windows on the same day | Second rejected by the exclusion constraint |
| Confirm back-to-back windows (end of one equals start of next) | Both accepted |
| Two sessions confirming overlapping windows at the same moment | Exactly one succeeded; the other waited and was refused |
| Design request carrying an event date | Rejected |
| Skip a status (quoted to completed, quoted to confirmed) | Rejected by the status guard |
| Send a quote whose total differs from its items; edit a sent quote or its items | Rejected |
| accept\_quote with the right token, a second time, and a wrong token | Accepted once; second refused (invalid\_state); wrong token refused (not\_found) |
| Publish a portfolio item without consent; add an image without alt text | Both rejected |
| Update a payment | Rejected (append-only) |
| Public availability view | Returned the confirmed day and every day in the blocked range, nothing else |
| Anonymous role: read bookings, read the outbox, read portfolio, call the booking function | 0 rows; 0 rows; published item only; call denied |
| Admin role at aal1 versus aal2; admin without the content scope writing services | aal1 sees 0 rows; aal2 sees rows; write refused by policy |
| Anonymise a closed booking older than 24 months | Personal fields replaced; row kept |

<table><tbody><tr><td><strong>WHAT WAS NOT VERIFIED</strong><br>Behaviour against Supabase’s own auth service (JWT claims such as aal are assumed from its documented shape and must be tested against the staging project).<br>Query performance on realistic data, and backup and restore.<br>The enquiry retention delete, which is specified above but not yet written.<br>These belong in the first sprint’s test list.</td></tr></tbody></table>

9.1 Phase 2 changes already accommodated
----------------------------------------

Appendix A: complete schema (hephzibah\_schema.sql)
===================================================

Run the sections in order. Section 0007 and 0008 contain the functions and policies the application depends on.  
\-- Hephzibah Media: backend schema v1.0 (PostgreSQL 15+ on Supabase)  
\-- Forward-only. Apply in order. Money is integer pesewas (GHS minor units).  
  
\-- ============ 0001 extensions, enums, helpers ============  
create extension if not exists btree\_gist;  
create extension if not exists citext;  
  
create type service\_kind as enum ('photography','videography','design');  
create type booking\_status as enum ('new','reviewing','quoted','accepted','confirmed','completed','declined','cancelled','expired');  
create type quote\_status as enum ('draft','sent','accepted','expired','superseded','withdrawn');  
create type contact\_method as enum ('whatsapp','phone','email');  
create type time\_of\_day as enum ('morning','afternoon','evening','all\_day','unsure');  
create type media\_type as enum ('image','video\_embed');  
create type video\_provider as enum ('youtube','vimeo');  
create type publish\_status as enum ('draft','published');  
create type payment\_method as enum ('momo','bank\_transfer','cash','card');  
create type payment\_provider as enum ('manual','paystack');  
create type outbox\_status as enum ('pending','sent','failed','dead');  
create type enquiry\_status as enum ('new','replied','spam','closed');  
  
create function set\_updated\_at() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$  
begin new.updated\_at = now(); return new; end $$;  
  
create function forbid\_update() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$  
begin raise exception '% is append-only', tg\_table\_name; end $$;  
  
\-- ============ 0002 admin identity ============  
create table admin\_users (  
id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,  
display\_name text not null check (char\_length(display\_name) between 1 and 80),  
scopes text\[\] not null default '{}',  
is\_active boolean not null default true,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
constraint admin\_scopes\_valid check (scopes <@ array\['bookings','content','settings','team'\])  
);  
  
\-- true only for an active admin holding the scope AND a TOTP-verified session (aal2)  
create function has\_scope(s text) returns boolean  
language sql stable security definer set search\_path = public as $$  
select exists (select 1 from admin\_users a  
where a.id = auth.uid() and a.is\_active and s = any(a.scopes))  
and coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'aal', 'aal1') = 'aal2';  
$$;  
  
\-- ============ 0003 catalogue ============  
create table occasions (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
slug text not null unique check (slug ~ '^\[a-z0-9\]+(-\[a-z0-9\]+)\*$'),  
name text not null,  
applies\_to service\_kind\[\] not null check (cardinality(applies\_to) > 0),  
sort\_order integer not null default 0,  
is\_active boolean not null default true  
);  
  
create table services (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
kind service\_kind not null,  
slug text not null unique check (slug ~ '^\[a-z0-9\]+(-\[a-z0-9\]+)\*$'),  
name text not null,  
summary text not null,  
description\_md text,  
starting\_price\_minor integer check (starting\_price\_minor >= 0),  
currency char(3) not null default 'GHS',  
sort\_order integer not null default 0,  
is\_active boolean not null default true,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
create trigger services\_updated before update on services for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();  
  
create table packages (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
service\_id uuid not null references services(id) on delete restrict,  
name text not null,  
summary text,  
price\_minor integer not null check (price\_minor >= 0),  
currency char(3) not null default 'GHS',  
duration\_hours numeric(4,1) check (duration\_hours > 0),  
deliverables text\[\] not null default '{}',  
is\_featured boolean not null default false,  
sort\_order integer not null default 0,  
is\_active boolean not null default true,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
create index packages\_service\_idx on packages (service\_id, sort\_order) where is\_active;  
create trigger packages\_updated before update on packages for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();  
  
\-- ============ 0004 bookings, quotes, payments ============  
create table bookings (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
reference text not null unique check (reference ~ '^HM-\[0-9\]{4}-\[A-Z2-9\]{5}$'),  
idempotency\_key text unique,  
access\_token\_hash text not null,  
status booking\_status not null default 'new',  
kind service\_kind not null,  
service\_id uuid not null references services(id) on delete restrict,  
package\_id uuid references packages(id) on delete set null,  
occasion\_id uuid references occasions(id) on delete set null,  
occasion\_other text check (char\_length(occasion\_other) <= 80),  
client\_name text not null check (char\_length(client\_name) between 2 and 120),  
client\_email citext not null check (client\_email ~\* '^\[^@\\s\]+@\[^@\\s\]+\\.\[^@\\s\]+$'),  
client\_phone text not null check (client\_phone ~ '^\\+?\[0-9 \]{9,16}$'),  
preferred\_contact contact\_method not null default 'whatsapp',  
event\_date date,  
time\_of\_day time\_of\_day,  
venue\_text text check (char\_length(venue\_text) <= 200),  
venue\_city text check (char\_length(venue\_city) <= 80),  
guest\_count integer check (guest\_count between 1 and 20000),  
deadline date,  
brief text not null check (char\_length(brief) between 10 and 4000),  
budget\_band text check (char\_length(budget\_band) <= 40),  
reference\_links text\[\] not null default '{}' check (cardinality(reference\_links) <= 5),  
source text check (char\_length(source) <= 40),  
starts\_at timestamptz,  
ends\_at timestamptz,  
accepted\_quote\_id uuid,  
cancelled\_reason text check (char\_length(cancelled\_reason) <= 500),  
privacy\_version text not null,  
terms\_version text not null,  
consented\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
constraint booking\_date\_shape check (kind = 'design' or event\_date is not null),  
constraint booking\_design\_dates check (kind <> 'design' or event\_date is null),  
constraint booking\_window\_order check (starts\_at is null or (ends\_at is not null and ends\_at > starts\_at)),  
constraint booking\_confirmed\_window check (  
status not in ('confirmed','completed') or kind = 'design' or (starts\_at is not null and ends\_at is not null))  
);  
\-- The invariant that matters most: one crew, no two confirmed jobs overlap.  
alter table bookings add constraint bookings\_no\_crew\_overlap  
exclude using gist (tstzrange(starts\_at, ends\_at, '\[)') with &&)  
where (status = 'confirmed' and kind <> 'design');  
create index bookings\_inbox\_idx on bookings (status, created\_at desc);  
create index bookings\_calendar\_idx on bookings (event\_date) where status in ('quoted','accepted','confirmed');  
create index bookings\_email\_idx on bookings (client\_email);  
create trigger bookings\_updated before update on bookings for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();  
  
\-- The booking state machine is enforced here, not only in application code.  
create function bookings\_status\_guard() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$  
begin  
if new.status = old.status then return new; end if;  
if (old.status, new.status) in (  
('new','reviewing'), ('new','declined'), ('new','cancelled'),  
('reviewing','quoted'), ('reviewing','declined'), ('reviewing','cancelled'),  
('quoted','reviewing'), ('quoted','accepted'), ('quoted','declined'), ('quoted','expired'), ('quoted','cancelled'),  
('accepted','confirmed'), ('accepted','cancelled'),  
('confirmed','completed'), ('confirmed','cancelled'),  
('expired','reviewing')  
) then return new; end if;  
raise exception 'illegal booking transition % -> %', old.status, new.status using errcode = 'P0001';  
end $$;  
create trigger bookings\_status\_guard\_trg before update of status on bookings  
for each row execute function bookings\_status\_guard();  
  
create table quotes (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
booking\_id uuid not null references bookings(id) on delete cascade,  
version integer not null check (version > 0),  
status quote\_status not null default 'draft',  
currency char(3) not null default 'GHS',  
total\_minor integer not null check (total\_minor >= 0),  
deposit\_minor integer not null default 0 check (deposit\_minor >= 0),  
valid\_until timestamptz,  
notes text,  
sent\_at timestamptz,  
accepted\_at timestamptz,  
created\_by uuid references admin\_users(id),  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
unique (booking\_id, version),  
constraint quote\_deposit\_le\_total check (deposit\_minor <= total\_minor)  
);  
create unique index quotes\_one\_sent\_per\_booking on quotes (booking\_id) where status = 'sent';  
alter table bookings add constraint bookings\_accepted\_quote\_fk  
foreign key (accepted\_quote\_id) references quotes(id) deferrable initially deferred;  
  
create table quote\_items (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
quote\_id uuid not null references quotes(id) on delete cascade,  
position smallint not null,  
description text not null check (char\_length(description) between 1 and 200),  
quantity numeric(8,2) not null default 1 check (quantity > 0),  
unit\_price\_minor integer not null check (unit\_price\_minor >= 0),  
line\_total\_minor integer generated always as (round(quantity \* unit\_price\_minor)::integer) stored,  
unique (quote\_id, position)  
);  
  
\-- Snapshot pricing: a quote's money fields freeze once it leaves draft.  
create function quotes\_guard() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$  
declare v\_sum integer;  
begin  
if old.status <> 'draft' and (new.total\_minor <> old.total\_minor or new.deposit\_minor <> old.deposit\_minor  
or new.booking\_id <> old.booking\_id or new.version <> old.version) then  
raise exception 'quote % is frozen', old.id;  
end if;  
if old.status = 'draft' and new.status = 'sent' then  
select coalesce(sum(line\_total\_minor), 0) into v\_sum from quote\_items where quote\_id = new.id;  
if v\_sum <> new.total\_minor then  
raise exception 'quote total % does not match item sum %', new.total\_minor, v\_sum;  
end if;  
end if;  
return new;  
end $$;  
create trigger quotes\_guard\_trg before update on quotes for each row execute function quotes\_guard();  
  
create function quote\_items\_guard() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$  
declare v\_status quote\_status; v\_id uuid;  
begin  
v\_id := coalesce(new.quote\_id, old.quote\_id);  
select status into v\_status from quotes where id = v\_id;  
if v\_status is not null and v\_status <> 'draft' then raise exception 'quote % is frozen', v\_id; end if;  
return coalesce(new, old);  
end $$;  
create trigger quote\_items\_guard\_trg before insert or update or delete on quote\_items  
for each row execute function quote\_items\_guard();  
  
create table payments (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
booking\_id uuid not null references bookings(id) on delete restrict,  
provider payment\_provider not null default 'manual',  
method payment\_method not null,  
amount\_minor integer not null check (amount\_minor > 0),  
is\_refund boolean not null default false,  
currency char(3) not null default 'GHS',  
provider\_reference text,  
received\_at timestamptz not null,  
note text,  
recorded\_by uuid references admin\_users(id),  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
unique (provider, provider\_reference)  
);  
create index payments\_booking\_idx on payments (booking\_id);  
create trigger payments\_immutable before update on payments for each row execute function forbid\_update();  
  
create table booking\_events (  
id bigint generated always as identity primary key,  
booking\_id uuid not null references bookings(id) on delete cascade,  
actor\_type text not null check (actor\_type in ('client','admin','system')),  
actor\_id uuid references admin\_users(id),  
event\_type text not null,  
from\_status booking\_status,  
to\_status booking\_status,  
note text,  
visible\_to\_client boolean not null default false,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
create index booking\_events\_idx on booking\_events (booking\_id, created\_at);  
create trigger booking\_events\_immutable before update on booking\_events for each row execute function forbid\_update();  
  
create table blocked\_dates (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
during daterange not null check (not isempty(during)),  
reason text not null,  
created\_by uuid references admin\_users(id),  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
create index blocked\_dates\_during\_idx on blocked\_dates using gist (during);  
  
\-- ============ 0005 portfolio and site content ============  
create table portfolio\_items (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
kind service\_kind not null,  
slug text not null unique check (slug ~ '^\[a-z0-9\]+(-\[a-z0-9\]+)\*$'),  
title text not null,  
summary text,  
occasion\_id uuid references occasions(id) on delete set null,  
shot\_on date,  
location\_text text,  
status publish\_status not null default 'draft',  
is\_featured boolean not null default false,  
sort\_order integer not null default 0,  
client\_consent\_to\_publish boolean not null default false,  
consent\_note text,  
published\_at timestamptz,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
constraint published\_requires\_consent check (status <> 'published' or client\_consent\_to\_publish),  
constraint published\_has\_timestamp check (status <> 'published' or published\_at is not null)  
);  
create index portfolio\_public\_idx on portfolio\_items (kind, sort\_order) where status = 'published';  
create trigger portfolio\_updated before update on portfolio\_items for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();  
  
create table media\_assets (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
portfolio\_item\_id uuid not null references portfolio\_items(id) on delete cascade,  
type media\_type not null,  
position smallint not null default 0,  
is\_cover boolean not null default false,  
cloudinary\_public\_id text,  
poster\_public\_id text,  
width integer check (width > 0),  
height integer check (height > 0),  
alt\_text text,  
video\_provider video\_provider,  
video\_id text,  
duration\_seconds integer check (duration\_seconds > 0),  
caption text,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
constraint image\_shape check (type <> 'image' or  
(cloudinary\_public\_id is not null and width is not null and height is not null and char\_length(coalesce(alt\_text, '')) > 0)),  
constraint video\_shape check (type <> 'video\_embed' or  
(video\_provider is not null and video\_id is not null and poster\_public\_id is not null))  
);  
create unique index media\_one\_cover on media\_assets (portfolio\_item\_id) where is\_cover;  
create index media\_item\_idx on media\_assets (portfolio\_item\_id, position);  
  
create table testimonials (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
author\_name text not null,  
author\_context text,  
quote text not null check (char\_length(quote) between 20 and 600),  
booking\_id uuid references bookings(id) on delete set null,  
consent\_to\_publish boolean not null default false,  
status publish\_status not null default 'draft',  
sort\_order integer not null default 0,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
constraint testimonial\_consent check (status <> 'published' or consent\_to\_publish)  
);  
create trigger testimonials\_updated before update on testimonials for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();  
  
create table faqs (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
question text not null,  
answer text not null,  
sort\_order integer not null default 0,  
is\_published boolean not null default true  
);  
  
create table enquiries (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
name text not null check (char\_length(name) between 2 and 120),  
email citext not null check (email ~\* '^\[^@\\s\]+@\[^@\\s\]+\\.\[^@\\s\]+$'),  
phone text check (phone ~ '^\\+?\[0-9 \]{9,16}$'),  
message text not null check (char\_length(message) between 10 and 3000),  
status enquiry\_status not null default 'new',  
privacy\_version text not null,  
consented\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
create index enquiries\_inbox\_idx on enquiries (status, created\_at desc);  
  
create table legal\_documents (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
slug text not null check (slug in ('terms','privacy','booking-policy')),  
version text not null,  
title text not null,  
body\_md text not null,  
effective\_at timestamptz not null,  
summary\_of\_changes text,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
unique (slug, version)  
);  
create view current\_legal\_documents as  
select distinct on (slug) \* from legal\_documents  
where effective\_at <= now() order by slug, effective\_at desc;  
  
create table site\_settings (  
id smallint primary key default 1 check (id = 1),  
business\_name text not null default 'Hephzibah Media',  
contact\_email citext not null,  
whatsapp\_e164 text not null check (whatsapp\_e164 ~ '^\\+\[1-9\]\[0-9\]{7,14}$'),  
phone\_e164 text,  
address\_text text,  
social jsonb not null default '{}',  
min\_lead\_days smallint not null default 3 check (min\_lead\_days >= 0),  
max\_advance\_days smallint not null default 540,  
quote\_validity\_days smallint not null default 7 check (quote\_validity\_days > 0),  
budget\_bands jsonb not null default '\[\]',  
updated\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
create trigger site\_settings\_updated before update on site\_settings for each row execute function set\_updated\_at();  
  
\-- ============ 0006 outbox ============  
create table email\_outbox (  
id uuid primary key default gen\_random\_uuid(),  
dedupe\_key text not null unique,  
to\_email citext not null,  
template text not null,  
payload jsonb not null,  
status outbox\_status not null default 'pending',  
attempts smallint not null default 0,  
next\_attempt\_at timestamptz not null default now(),  
last\_error text,  
sent\_at timestamptz,  
created\_at timestamptz not null default now()  
);  
create index email\_outbox\_due\_idx on email\_outbox (next\_attempt\_at) where status in ('pending','failed');  
  
\-- ============ 0007 transactional entry points (service role only) ============  
create function create\_booking\_request(p jsonb) returns text  
language plpgsql security definer set search\_path = public as $$  
declare v\_id uuid; v\_ref text;  
begin  
insert into bookings (reference, idempotency\_key, access\_token\_hash, kind, service\_id, package\_id, occasion\_id,  
occasion\_other, client\_name, client\_email, client\_phone, preferred\_contact, event\_date, time\_of\_day,  
venue\_text, venue\_city, guest\_count, deadline, brief, budget\_band, reference\_links, source,  
privacy\_version, terms\_version)  
values (p->>'reference', p->>'idempotency\_key', p->>'access\_token\_hash', (p->>'kind')::service\_kind,  
(p->>'service\_id')::uuid, nullif(p->>'package\_id','')::uuid, nullif(p->>'occasion\_id','')::uuid,  
nullif(p->>'occasion\_other',''), p->>'client\_name', (p->>'client\_email')::citext, p->>'client\_phone',  
coalesce(nullif(p->>'preferred\_contact','')::contact\_method, 'whatsapp'),  
nullif(p->>'event\_date','')::date, nullif(p->>'time\_of\_day','')::time\_of\_day,  
nullif(p->>'venue\_text',''), nullif(p->>'venue\_city',''), nullif(p->>'guest\_count','')::integer,  
nullif(p->>'deadline','')::date, p->>'brief', nullif(p->>'budget\_band',''),  
array(select jsonb\_array\_elements\_text(coalesce(p->'reference\_links', '\[\]'::jsonb))),  
nullif(p->>'source',''), p->>'privacy\_version', p->>'terms\_version')  
on conflict (idempotency\_key) do nothing  
returning id, reference into v\_id, v\_ref;  
  
if v\_id is null then -- replay of the same submission: return the original reference  
select reference into v\_ref from bookings where idempotency\_key = p->>'idempotency\_key';  
return v\_ref;  
end if;  
  
insert into booking\_events (booking\_id, actor\_type, event\_type, to\_status, visible\_to\_client)  
values (v\_id, 'client', 'request\_submitted', 'new', true);  
insert into email\_outbox (dedupe\_key, to\_email, template, payload) values  
('booking-received:' || v\_id, (p->>'client\_email')::citext, 'booking\_received', jsonb\_build\_object('booking\_id', v\_id)),  
('admin-new-request:' || v\_id, (select contact\_email from site\_settings where id = 1), 'admin\_new\_request', jsonb\_build\_object('booking\_id', v\_id));  
return v\_ref;  
end $$;  
  
create function accept\_quote(p\_reference text, p\_token\_hash text, p\_quote\_id uuid) returns void  
language plpgsql security definer set search\_path = public as $$  
declare b bookings%rowtype;  
begin  
select \* into b from bookings where reference = p\_reference and access\_token\_hash = p\_token\_hash for update;  
if not found then raise exception 'not\_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;  
if b.status <> 'quoted' then raise exception 'invalid\_state' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;  
update quotes set status = 'accepted', accepted\_at = now()  
where id = p\_quote\_id and booking\_id = b.id and status = 'sent' and (valid\_until is null or valid\_until > now());  
if not found then raise exception 'quote\_unavailable' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;  
update bookings set status = 'accepted', accepted\_quote\_id = p\_quote\_id where id = b.id;  
insert into booking\_events (booking\_id, actor\_type, event\_type, from\_status, to\_status, visible\_to\_client)  
values (b.id, 'client', 'quote\_accepted', 'quoted', 'accepted', true);  
insert into email\_outbox (dedupe\_key, to\_email, template, payload) values  
('admin-quote-accepted:' || p\_quote\_id, (select contact\_email from site\_settings where id = 1), 'admin\_quote\_accepted', jsonb\_build\_object('booking\_id', b.id));  
end $$;  
  
revoke execute on function create\_booking\_request(jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated;  
revoke execute on function accept\_quote(text, text, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated;  
grant execute on function create\_booking\_request(jsonb) to service\_role;  
grant execute on function accept\_quote(text, text, uuid) to service\_role;  
  
\-- Public availability: dates only, never details. Runs with owner rights on purpose.  
create view public\_unavailable\_dates with (security\_invoker = false) as  
select d::date as day  
from blocked\_dates b, generate\_series(lower(b.during), upper(b.during) - 1, interval '1 day') d  
where d::date >= current\_date  
union  
select (starts\_at at time zone 'Africa/Accra')::date  
from bookings  
where status = 'confirmed' and kind <> 'design' and starts\_at is not null  
and (starts\_at at time zone 'Africa/Accra')::date >= current\_date;  
  
\-- ============ 0008 row level security ============  
do $$ declare t text; begin  
foreach t in array array\['admin\_users','occasions','services','packages','bookings','quotes','quote\_items','payments',  
'booking\_events','blocked\_dates','portfolio\_items','media\_assets','testimonials','faqs','enquiries',  
'legal\_documents','site\_settings','email\_outbox'\] loop  
execute format('alter table %I enable row level security', t);  
end loop;  
end $$;  
  
\-- public reads (published or active rows only)  
create policy occasions\_public on occasions for select to anon, authenticated using (is\_active);  
create policy services\_public on services for select to anon, authenticated using (is\_active);  
create policy packages\_public on packages for select to anon, authenticated using (is\_active);  
create policy portfolio\_public on portfolio\_items for select to anon, authenticated using (status = 'published');  
create policy media\_public on media\_assets for select to anon, authenticated  
using (exists (select 1 from portfolio\_items p where p.id = portfolio\_item\_id and p.status = 'published'));  
create policy testimonials\_public on testimonials for select to anon, authenticated using (status = 'published');  
create policy faqs\_public on faqs for select to anon, authenticated using (is\_published);  
create policy legal\_public on legal\_documents for select to anon, authenticated using (effective\_at <= now());  
create policy settings\_public on site\_settings for select to anon, authenticated using (true);  
grant select on public\_unavailable\_dates, current\_legal\_documents to anon, authenticated;  
  
\-- admin writes, scoped  
do $$ declare t text; begin  
foreach t in array array\['occasions','services','packages','portfolio\_items','media\_assets','testimonials','faqs'\] loop  
execute format('create policy %I on %I for all to authenticated using (has\_scope(''content'')) with check (has\_scope(''content''))', t || '\_admin', t);  
end loop;  
foreach t in array array\['bookings','quotes','quote\_items','payments','booking\_events','blocked\_dates','enquiries'\] loop  
execute format('create policy %I on %I for all to authenticated using (has\_scope(''bookings'')) with check (has\_scope(''bookings''))', t || '\_admin', t);  
end loop;  
end $$;  
create policy settings\_admin on site\_settings for update to authenticated using (has\_scope('settings')) with check (has\_scope('settings'));  
create policy legal\_admin on legal\_documents for all to authenticated using (has\_scope('settings')) with check (has\_scope('settings'));  
create policy admin\_self on admin\_users for select to authenticated using (id = auth.uid());  
create policy admin\_team on admin\_users for all to authenticated using (has\_scope('team')) with check (has\_scope('team'));  
\-- email\_outbox and idempotent RPCs: no policy = service role only.  
  
\-- ============ 0009 retention ============  
create function anonymise\_old\_bookings(p\_months integer default 24) returns integer  
language plpgsql security definer set search\_path = public as $$  
declare n integer;  
begin  
update bookings set client\_name = 'Anonymised', client\_email = ('anonymised+' || id || '@invalid.example')::citext,  
client\_phone = '+000000000', brief = '\[removed by retention policy\]', venue\_text = null,  
reference\_links = '{}', access\_token\_hash = 'revoked', idempotency\_key = null  
where status in ('completed','declined','cancelled','expired')  
and coalesce(event\_date, deadline, created\_at::date) < (current\_date - make\_interval(months => p\_months))  
and client\_name <> 'Anonymised';  
get diagnostics n = row\_count;  
return n;  
end $$;  
revoke execute on function anonymise\_old\_bookings(integer) from public, anon, authenticated;  
grant execute on function anonymise\_old\_bookings(integer) to service\_role;
